name: São Paulo
tagline: South America's food, art and nightlife megacity
summary: São Paulo is South America's largest city and its cultural engine, with world-class restaurants, museums and nightlife. See the MASP art museum on Avenida Paulista, eat a mortadella sandwich at the Mercadão, wander the graffiti of Beco do Batman and Liberdade's Japanese quarter, and relax in Ibirapuera Park.
seasonNote: Autumn and winter (April to September) are dry and mild; summer has afternoon storms.
arrival: Guarulhos International is 45 to 90 minutes away by traffic; Congonhas serves domestic flights.
gettingAround: Metro is fast; Uber and 99 apps for nights.
cashTip: Cards and Pix are everywhere; carry a little cash for beach vendors and keep valuables out of sight.
foodTip: Mortadella sandwich, pizza paulistana and Japanese food in Liberdade.
buyTip: Brazilian design in Vila Madalena and Havaianas.

connections.note: Air shuttle every few minutes; 6 hours by bus.
